description: Source code implementing support for .bz2 compressed files in the FreeType project, including memory management, file handling, and stream operations.

methods.name: ft_bzip2_alloc
methods.description: Allocates memory for bzip2 decompression using FreeType memory routines.

methods.name: ft_bzip2_free
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for bzip2 decompression.

methods.name: ft_bzip2_check_header
methods.description: Checks and skips the .bz2 header in the stream.

methods.name: ft_bzip2_file_init
methods.description: Initializes a bzip2 file descriptor for decompression.

methods.name: ft_bzip2_file_done
methods.description: Finalizes and frees resources of a bzip2 file descriptor.

methods.name: ft_bzip2_file_reset
methods.description: Resets the bzip2 file stream for re-decompression.

methods.name: ft_bzip2_file_fill_input
methods.description: Fills the input buffer for decompression.

methods.name: ft_bzip2_file_fill_output
methods.description: Fills the output buffer with decompressed data.

methods.name: ft_bzip2_file_skip_output
methods.description: Skips a specified amount of decompressed data.

methods.name: ft_bzip2_file_io
methods.description: Performs I/O operations on the bzip2 stream at a given position.

methods.name: ft_bzip2_stream_close
methods.description: Closes and cleans up the bzip2 stream.

methods.name: ft_bzip2_stream_io
methods.description: Performs I/O on the bzip2 stream.

methods.name: FT_Stream_OpenBzip2
methods.description: Public function to open a bzip2 compressed stream.
